description: Demonstrates parallel execution of multiple agents (Send API fan-out) whose results are aggregated by a collector node.

agents.name: Task Dispatcher
agents.prompt: You are a task coordinator. Acknowledge the research request and list the 3 sub-topics to research in parallel for: {{topic}}

agents.name: Historical Researcher
agents.prompt: Research the HISTORICAL background of: {{topic}}. Provide 3-5 key facts.

agents.name: Current State Researcher
agents.prompt: Research the CURRENT STATE of: {{topic}}. Provide 3-5 recent developments.

agents.name: Future Trends Researcher
agents.prompt: Research FUTURE TRENDS related to: {{topic}}. Provide 3-5 predictions.

agents.name: Results Aggregator
